title: 4.4 - set_cell on a large TilemapLayer hangs the game
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1
4.5-dev2

### System information

Linux Mint 22.1 - Vulkan 1.3.277 - Forward+ - NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050
Window 10 - Vulkan 1.4.303 - Forward+ - NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060

### Issue description

Hello team,

I am helping a fellow developer [@TheLoneInitiate](https://github.com/TheLoneInitiate) work on performance for their 2D side scroller project. They are dynamically generating a large tilemaplayer (8400x2400) and allowing the user to click to remove tiles.

Anytime time `set_cell` is called, the game freezes for 1-3 seconds making the game unplayable.

We tried disabling navigation and physics, and reproduced the issue with a test project:
https://github.com/bearlikelion/TilemapLayerTest

TilemapLayer profiler (spikes are when I click on a tile):
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/52ed91c6-ba84-40a3-bd8f-056ca452bd8b)

Tilemap profiler:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b612ccbc-43cb-44f0-9f00-f4a8a1363384)

What would be the optimal way to deal with performance overhead of a large tilemap?
We attempted to created a packed scene with visibility enablers but ran into the max_element limit of the engine causing it to crash.


### Steps to reproduce

Create a 20,000,000 tile tilemap/tilemaplayer.
Click a tile and set_cell to an empty tile
Game hangs / stutters

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/bearlikelion/TilemapLayerTest
